verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both have the same serious flaws. The S-A-L-E letters have shrunk to tiny type and slipped out of their circles: S sits at the bottom of its circle and A straddles the edge between two circles. This wrecks the main SALE message, and the column of circles is pushed against the right edge. 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' is a tiny line in the top-left. The decorative lanterns, clouds and ingots are duplicated into two stacked copies that fill the canvas, so nothing stands out as the main element. Because the layout is the same, neither one is the better resize.
